observations.content:
Summary: The "Attention Is All You Need" paper was published in 2017 and introduced the Transformer architecture, a novel deep learning model based solely on attention mechanisms. The paper, authored by Ashish Vaswani, Noam Shazeer, Niki Parmar, Jakob Uszkoreit, Llion Jones, Aidan N Gomez, Łukasz Kaiser, and Illia Polosukhin, was presented at the 31st Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NIPS) and has since become foundational in the field of natural language processing and machine learning. The Transformer architecture has been instrumental in advancing the state-of-the-art in translation and other sequence-to-sequence tasks.

我用自己的话总结了一下：transformer，从NLP领域开启的生成式AI的革命。它的核心就是注意力，最知名的就是论文中的注意力公式。运用注意力机制，建立自然语言的句子/段落的全局视野。获取某token和任意一个token的关联的时间复杂度永远是O（1）。该论文一开始是作为seq2seq，处理自然语言的。它的架构是编码器-解码器架构，然后，采用多头注意力机制，其实就是一个注意力机制做n次，理解的更深更多角度。同时它支持并行。相比于RNN的串行，它的速度并行效率极佳。相比于CNN的视野局限，它直接拥有全局视野，上帝视角。于是，革命开始了。在2017年。
